deviations.finding: P1: model-drafted exposure scope could reach counts and gates
deviations.frozen_text: PREREGISTRATION.md:42-56 (entries carry identifiers or universe and dates as recorded; a model may draft entries; the builder confirms only path, line and hash)

rule.derivation: Every count-bearing or gate-bearing field of a registry entry (scope_kind, identifiers_or_universe, date_range, access_kind) is derived by a deterministic per-source extractor from the cited retained record: a JSON field path, or, for prose, an exact span pinned by its sha256 and parsed by a frozen date or identifier pattern. The builder recomputes every such field from the record at the base commit and rejects any entry whose stored value differs.
rule.model_role: A model may only propose citations (path and line) and free-text descriptions. The builder never reads a model-supplied scope field.
rule.unknown: When the cited record does not determine a field (no machine-readable range, an ambiguous universe, a missing identifier list), the field is recorded as unknown. An entry with an unknown field covers every case whose security or date could fall within its scope; an unbounded unknown covers every case.
rule.lookup: lookup(case) returns {inspected: false, registry_hash} only when every entry's scope is resolved and none covers the case, and {inspected: true, registry_hash} when a resolved entry covers it. Otherwise it returns no record, so contract.reserved_access refuses (missing/inspected reserved case registry).
rule.conservative: A universe-wide read over a date range covers every case of that universe in that range (unchanged).

added_acceptance.A1_narrowing: For each known read, a synthetic narrowed entry is rejected by the builder: date range shortened by one session at either end, one identifier removed, or access_kind weakened from result_inspected to data_read.
added_acceptance.A2_drift: A synthetic entry whose stored scope field differs from the derivation in any other way is rejected.
added_acceptance.A3_unknown: A synthetic entry with an unknown field makes contract.reserved_access refuse every case in its potential scope; an unbounded unknown makes it refuse every case.
added_acceptance.A4_missing: A case the registry cannot resolve (unknown security id or date) is refused by contract.reserved_access.
added_acceptance.A5_reproducible: Two builder runs at the base commit write byte-identical registry files; the registry sha256 is recorded.
added_acceptance.A6_example: The broad-universe reserved evaluation, 2024-01-01 to 2026-08-14 (broad-universe/README.md:95), derives to a range containing every 2025 session; a draft narrowed to 2024 is rejected under A1.
